Tumor-vessel rescue is a precedent, not evidence that this complete adult repair route has been demonstrated. a28-th17-regulatory-effector-arms.source_excerpt: **Hypothesis and biology.** Regulatory and effector competence are separately regulated within the same Th17 cell rather than two ends of one axis, so a perturbation can remove one without adding the other. Nutrient restriction is predicted to lower per-cell Foxp3 and CTLA4 protein with IL-17 unchanged, and a pathogenic cytokine condition to raise IL-17 with Foxp3 and CTLA4 unchanged. A single latent axis predicts that both perturbations move both proteins reciprocally. No causal claim about which competence is upstream is implied.
a28-th17-regulatory-effector-arms.rationale: Draft discovery nomination grounded in the pinned A28 context; broad retrieval does not require the predicted direction. Joint regulatory and effector proteins are the proposed discriminator; one-sided module shifts do not establish independent competence or exclude composition.

a28-th17-regulatory-effector-arms.interpretation_limits: Joint regulatory and effector proteins are the proposed discriminator; one-sided module shifts do not establish independent competence or exclude composition.

a29-pgam-th17-effector.source_excerpt: **Hypothesis and biology.** PGAM restriction raises Th17 effector output by lowering the phosphoenolpyruvate pool and relieving PEP-mediated inhibition of the JunB/BATF/IRF4 complex, rather than by inducing a stress response; relief of biosynthetic and proliferative demand is a third, separable possibility. The PEP route predicts that the PEP pool falls under PGAM inhibition and that PEP supplementation abolishes the effector gain; the demand route predicts that matched growth slowing without PGAM inhibition reproduces it. No mechanism here is proposed as new, and a transcript-level observation cannot establish any of them.
a29-pgam-th17-effector.rationale: Draft discovery nomination grounded in the pinned A29 context; broad retrieval does not require the predicted direction. Preserve PEP-pool, stress and growth-demand alternatives; genetic loss, drug effects, label ratios and absolute metabolite pools are distinct evidence.

a29-pgam-th17-effector.interpretation_limits: Preserve PEP-pool, stress and growth-demand alternatives; genetic loss, drug effects, label ratios and absolute metabolite pools are distinct evidence.
